# NextVisa

> NextVisa is a Kazakhstan-based visa support and travel-planning brand. It helps travelers understand visa processes, organize application materials, and plan international trips. It does not make visa decisions and does not guarantee approvals.

## Main website
- https://nextvisa.vercel.app/

## Consultation
- https://nextvisa.vercel.app/#lead-form

## Destination information
- Schengen: https://nextvisa.vercel.app/visa/schengen.html
- United States: https://nextvisa.vercel.app/visa/usa.html
- United Kingdom: https://nextvisa.vercel.app/visa/uk.html
- Canada: https://nextvisa.vercel.app/visa/canada.html
- Australia: https://nextvisa.vercel.app/visa/australia.html

## Services
- Initial visa and travel consultation
- Preparation roadmap and document organization
- Document consistency review
- Support within an agreed scope of services

## Important limitations
- Visa requirements, eligibility, fees, processing times, appointment availability and document lists change. Confirm them with the relevant official government or consular authority.
- Visa decisions are made solely by competent authorities. NextVisa does not guarantee an outcome.
- Government and consular fees are separate from any agency service fee.
- Do not send passport scans, financial records or sensitive personal documents through the initial enquiry form.

## Official sources
Each destination page links to the relevant official government source (European Commission, U.S. Department of State, GOV.UK, IRCC, or Australian Department of Home Affairs).
